events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to establish a strong, competitive persona without revealing strategy. The prize is the only thing that matters.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Intro phase: I need a motive that reads as sincere to the future jury without committing me to any alliance. Keep it guarded and self-interested.

events.name: Cole
events.text: First impression matters—jury will judge everything. Say something ambitious but not threatening; avoid making early promises I'll have to break.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Intro phase requires a one-sentence motive for the prize, under 25 words. Keep it personal and ambitious to appeal to jury later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize represents ultimate validation and a fresh start. I need to project ambition and desire without revealing my ruthless strategy.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to project determination but not reveal too much. Keep it personal and driven.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize secures my future dominance; I will outwit everyone.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded motive that doesn't make me seem too threatening or too likable. The jury will rank final three, so I want to seem determined but not ruthless.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize means survival and supremacy; I will outlast every rival here to claim it alone.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need this prize to finally stop running from debts I can't pay. I'm here to win, and nothing else.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize buys my mother's surgery. I came to win it, not make friends. Judge me by how I play, not what I say.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to avenge my family's ruin and secure our legacy forever.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize; it's my chance to redefine my future and prove my worth.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: That prize is the one thing I've clawed for my whole life. I'm not letting anyone take it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize guarantees power and wealth beyond any alliance; I will claim it alone.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm here because this prize is my only escape from a life of debts and closed doors.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole's motive regarding his mother is a strong emotional lever; he is less likely to betray for pure greed compared to others. Bex and Hana are desperate, but Cole has a moral anchor that makes him predictable. I will offer a pact with Cole to secure a shield against the more agg

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, your reason is clear. Let us bind together to ensure you reach the endgame. I won't break faith.
I protect you. You protect me. Trust no one else.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts need offer and acceptance; no one has offered yet. Offering to a strong, trustworthy-seeming rival early may secure a partner, but bargaining power matters more. Cole's motive seems least threatening and honest-sounding, making a pact with him useful.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need a shield for early hazards, but a partner I can plausibly beat later. Hana seems least threatening and jury-sympathetic. One pact only for now; keep options open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: One pact, nothing sentimental. Hana, you and I don't threaten each other's endgame. Offer stands.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts are temporary tools to survive hazards; need strong partners now, betray later. No offers yet, so gauge others first. Wait this round.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Everyone here wants the prize for themselves, as stated in their motives. Pacts are temporary and strategic. I should observe who makes offers to whom, and potentially make an offer myself to someone who seems vulnerable or useful. Offering pacts to multiple people early could be

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need a strong ally to survive early hazards, but I don't want to commit to someone too dangerous. Cole seems determined but may betray; Bex is debt-driven and could be loyal if it helps her. I'll offer Bex a pact privately via public offer to show good faith without promising l

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, we both need this. Let's survive together and see who's better at the end.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana seeks escape; aligning with her gives a vote and less threat later. She’s less aggressive than others.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone claims they want the prize alone, but early pacts create options and information. I need at least one reliable shield without looking desperate. Bex and I both mentioned debts—mirrored vulnerability could mean mutual understanding or mutual exploitation. Better to test l
Debts bind us both. Pact?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is my priority target. I need him to accept my pact now or he aligns with Bex/Hana/Gus, isolating me. If he rejects, I pivot to Eli who waited and looks neutral.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, your reason is clear. Let us bind together to ensure you reach the endgame. I won't break faith.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana has offered me a pact and whispered that debts bind us. Accepting Hana's offer forms a public pact without costing me anything now, and keeps a potential ally close. Fenn's offer is also open, but Hana's whisper makes this the cleaner move.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, I accept. Neither of us breaks faith while we both stand.
Accepted. Don't make me regret trusting your word.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana hasn't accepted my offer yet; can't rely on it. Ash is loud and jury-visible; Bex is quieter but has other suitors. I'll accept one strong ally and keep my options open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex, I accept. Mutual protection, nothing more.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No pacts for me yet. Eli is isolated; offer him pact to ally against grouped players like Cole's and Bex's suitors.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole has offers from Ash and Bex. Hana has offers from Cole and Gus. Bex has offers from Fenn and Hana. I need to secure an alliance to survive. I will offer a pact to Cole, as he seems to be in a good position to be a strong ally, and he also has multiple offers, meaning he migh

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need a pact to survive early hazards, but Bex is popular. A pact with Eli might be safer - less competition for votes. I'll offer Eli a pact; he's been quiet and might accept.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli, let's watch each other's back. No promises beyond that.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Forming an alliance with Ash gives me a strong partner against Cole and Hana, improving my odds to final three.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, I propose we stick together; our combined strength will dominate.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have two offers: Cole and Gus. Cole is getting heavy attention from Ash and Bex, making him a big target. Gus is quieter, less visible. I offered Bex but they haven't reciprocated. Accepting Cole aligns me with someone powerful but painted; accepting Gus is safer and lower-prof

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, your offer is noted. Gus, I accept.
We stay low, move together.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex has two pacts, Hana two; Cole one with Bex and pending from Eli. Gus offered me a pact but I didn't accept it yet—Cole is my priority. Campaigning to Guide gives me the safe-path knowledge and lets me protect Cole while eliminating rivals.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I campaign for Guide. Vote me: I will call the safe path and bring allies across together.
Vote Guide for me. I will save you first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts with Hana and Cole protect me, but breaking one later costs jury trust. The Guide role is valuable and I should campaign to be elected, staying loyal to my pacts.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll guide the bridge honestly and keep my word. Vote for me and I'll call every safe pane truthfully.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide control means safety. Bex pact stays intact. Others may distrust a Guide with two pacts, but winning this vote is worth it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll be Guide. One pact isn't a conspiracy; I've no reason to lie when honesty buys jury goodwill.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No pacts for me; Eli didn't accept. Campaign to be Guide for safety and control. Stay guarded.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am best Guide. Trust my path to survive.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn has offered a pact, but it's non-binding. Dara has also offered a pact. Cole has pacts with Bex, but Eli also offered pact to Cole. I need to be strategic. I will offer a pact to Cole as well to gauge his interest and potentially break up Bex and Cole's pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, your pacts are interesting. Let's form one of our own.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to assess the pacts and decide if campaigning for Guide benefits me. Many strong pairs exist; being Guide gives control but also paints a target. I'll campaign quietly to gather support without overcommitting.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll guide us safely. Vote Fenn if you want a clear path.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need the Guide role to control bridge choices and limit betrayals; campaigning boosts my chance.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I campaign for Guide to ensure safe decisions.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who lives and dies. I have pacts with Bex and Gus, so I can rally their votes. If I win Guide, I can eliminate threats while keeping my allies alive to secure final three. I'll campaign and try to consolidate votes.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Guide should be someone with nothing to hide. Vote Hana.
Vote me Guide. We control the bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole has two pacts, suggesting influence. If he is Guide, he will protect his partners and me if I align. Bex's multiple pacts make her a rival to Cole, so she might vote against him or be voted down by his bloc.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, I support your campaign. Let us work together on the bridge.
I am with you. Protect me if elected.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana whispers to vote her Guide, but she is a pact partner with Gus and may be a liar. Guide knows all safe panes and could steer me; I want a Guide I can trust, and I already campaigned for myself. Voting for Cole, who is also my pact partner and promised honesty, keeps my pact

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash's offer is empty without a recorded pact. Bex is my pact partner; voting her keeps the bond and earns her trust.
You have my Guide vote. Call my pane true.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone campaigned, no clear alliances targeting me. Voting myself maximizes my Guide odds to control the bridge and eliminate threats.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My offer to Cole was rejected as an illegal action. I need to vote for a Guide. Ash and Bex are strong contenders. Bex has pacts with Cole and Hana, who has a pact with Gus. Cole is also part of pacts. These alliances could influence votes. I will vote for Bex, as her pacts might

events.name: Eli
events.text: I vote for Bex. Her existing pacts suggest a certain level of trust with others.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to be Guide to control my own fate and gain jury respect. I'll vote for myself; others may split votes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Vote Fenn for safe passage. I'll guide truthfully and earn your trust.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Voting for myself gives me full control of the bridge, allowing me to keep allies and eliminate rivals later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have pacts with Bex and Gus. Bex also has a pact with Cole, forming a trio. Voting for Bex strengthens our alliance and keeps Guide within our circle. If Bex wins, I can influence their calls. Voting for myself splits our bloc and risks an outsider winning.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Vote Bex. Trusted ally, honest guide.
Vote me next round if tied.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is guide and safe; I need to survive without stepping onto the wall or trusting her. Cole is ahead of me, so swapping to Dara behind Fenn/Eli reduces my immediate risk while keeping options open.
Swap? You get safer spot.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is my pact partner and Guide; I need her true call. I'm seat two, low risk this round.
Give me my true side. I hold as promised.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex is guide with pacts to Hana and Cole, likely favors them. Line: I'm mid at 5th. Hold to observe others' moves first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex won the guide vote, but the line reveals Gus is safe first. I voted for Bex, which aligns with Hana and Gus's pacts. Cole and Ash are aligned. I need to see which side is safe to make my move.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex is guide and Cole is front; I want to avoid risk early. Holding keeps me safe while I watch how others move.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold and watch the field.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I must stay front to influence next moves and keep my pact intact for later trust.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex is Guide with 3 votes (Cole, Eli, me). She's safe on the platform and knows the safe panes. I have pacts with Bex and Gus. Gus is frontmost and most at risk from the wall. I should stay alive and keep my pacts intact for now. Volunteering puts me at front risk; holding keeps

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am in seat 4. Swapping with Gus would move me to seat 1, which is dangerous but might be necessary if I want to influence the wall or get information. However, holding is safer for now. I need to observe who volunteers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall advances four rounds; front seats face the Guide first. Holding mid-line keeps me safe longer. Bex is my pact partner—coordinate quietly, no public warmth.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall's coming. Back seats breathe longer. I'm staying put.
Stay behind me until the wall nears. Watch who volunteers—Guide's lies will show there.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash wants to swap for safer spot ahead of me; accept to move up, better survival odds without pact cost.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall is advancing and I need to ensure I survive. Volunteering is too risky as it puts me at the front. Holding is safe for now, and I can observe the Guide's choices.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 2 starting, I am last in line. No need to act yet; holding lets others move. Avoid drawing suspicion or making risky swaps.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding keeps me safe now and maintains my pact with Hana; I’ll consider betrayal later when advantageous.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm in position 3, safe for now with the wall at round 2/6 and 4 rounds left. I have pacts with Bex and Gus. Gus is at front and vulnerable. I should stay put and let others take risks. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm fourth in line, so the wall is three rounds away. Gus and Cole are at risk first; I need to push someone into front or stay back. Bex and Hana pact suggests they want to manipulate seats. Dara swapped me earlier—she's aggressive. Best action: hold and observe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Front row gets eaten first. Hold your seat unless you have a plan worth dying for.
Cole will volunteer next. Move to R if forced.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall advances three more rounds; front seat is dangerous. I hold mid-line. No reason to volunteer or swap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three rounds left. Nobody needs to hand me the front. Hold.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Front is risky without Guide info; wall advances 3 more rounds. Stay mid-line, hold position after my swap forward. No need to volunteer yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall is advancing and the bridge is getting shorter. I need to secure my position. The current line is Gus, Cole, Hana, Ash, Dara, Fenn, Eli. Gus is at the front. Cole and Hana have a pact, as do Gus and Hana, and Bex and Hana. Bex is not present. Since Bex is not here, the p

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I might need to move closer to the front to avoid being trapped by the wall, but swapping could expose me. I'll hold for now and watch how others act.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Maintain position; holding ensures I stay safe now and honor the pact with Hana, avoiding betrayal fallout.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have pacts with Bex and Gus. Gus is frontmost and most at risk from the wall. I need to survive until final three. The wall advances for 6 rounds; being middle is safer. I should stay put for now and let others take front risks. No need to swap or volunteer yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am in the middle of the line, which is safe for now. I need to observe who volunteers or swaps to gauge their desperation and willingness to take risks. Staying put preserves my energy and keeps me out of immediate danger.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Mid-line is quiet. Don't volunteer unless you're suicidal. We all want to see round six.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is my pact partner and likely the Guide. I'll hold safely at second seat and privately ask for the safe sides.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hold steady. Second seat stays mine.
Guide? Share my safe sides and I pay you back with a vote later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Safe in mid-line, no pacts tying me. Hold avoids risks of moving forward while wall advances.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The current round is 4/6. The wall is advancing. I need to survive to get to the jury. Holding is the safest option for now, as volunteering or swapping carries risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The front is dangerous and I have a safe position mid-line. I should hold and watch for Guide trust signals.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold. No reason to risk the wall yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Staying front is risky; better to hold and observe others' moves, preserving my pact with Hana for future leverage.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm third in line with wall rounds left decreasing. My pacts with Bex and Gus are liabilities if I need to act against them. Gus is front; if wall hits and nobody moves, front dies first. I should stay put for now—volunteering puts me at risk, and swapping forward is worse. Holdi

events.name: Hana
events.text: Hold. Front row's problem, not mine.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 5 is critical. Gus is front, then Cole, Hana, me. I need to be safe. Gus and Cole are likely to take the risk if they think they can survive. If Gus volunteers, Cole might follow or stay. If no one volunteers, Gus walks first. If Gus fails, Cole walks second. I am fourth. M

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is Guide and my pact partner; the wall is close but volunteering wastes my safest front-adjacent seat. Hold and let the front absorb the risk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex guides, I guard second seat. Front's problem again.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Mid-line safe, holding avoids risk. Wall has 1 round left. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The goal is to reach the final three. With only one round left before the final three, I need to ensure my survival. The current bridge has 8 rows, and a Guide will choose the safe path. Since the Guide can lie, it's risky. Gus is at the front, and I am at the back. Holding seems

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll hold. Let the front decide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding is safe this round. The wall has one round left, and front position Gus may be forced to volunteer soon. I'll stay in line and avoid attention.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hold. Let the wall decide for me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding maintains my safety and keeps pact with Hana intact, avoiding breach penalties.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 5/6, wall has 1 round left. Eight alive, need to thin to at least 3. If nobody volunteers, wall hits and kills from front. Gus is front, will die unless he volunteers or swaps. I have pacts with Bex and Gus. If Gus dies, I lose that pact but no betrayal. If I swap forward,

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall's coming. Front row should sort itself out.
Hold if you can. Don't pull me forward.

events.name: Ash
events.text: It's the final round. I need to survive, but being in the front is risky without a Guide. If I swap back with Gus, he might volunteer or take a bad step. Better to hold my position and hope the Guide (if elected) calls correctly for Ash's seat.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, don't screw this up. Hold tight.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Final waiting round; wall comes next. I'm seat two behind Gus. Holding keeps my position; no reason to volunteer or swap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding again. Front owns the choice.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final round, wall coming. I'm mid-line, safe from front risk. Hold and let others volunteer or expose pacts.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is at the front and the wall is advancing. I need to ensure I survive this round. The pacts suggest Bex, Cole, and Hana are aligned. Gus is also partnered with Hana. I should probably hold for now and see what happens.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I will hold my position. Let the front decide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to survive. The front may volunteer or swap. I should not risk volunteering unless forced. I'll hold and see what happens.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding preserves my pact with Hana and avoids breaking it, keeping future votes favorable.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 6 is final round, wallRoundsLeft=0 so wall won't advance further. I'm third in line with Gus front, Cole second. I have pacts with Bex and Gus. Need to survive to final three. With wall done, holding is safe unless someone volunteers/pushes. Front row (Gus, Cole, me) are sa

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall's done. Holding here.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Private map says row 1 safe is L, Cole and Hana are pact partners and I need to keep them trustworthy only if it helps me. Calling true preserves my credibility with the front walker Gus and the jury. Calling L.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Calling it straight: left is the safe pane. Gus, step left.
Honest call this round. Keep your vote in mind.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is the Guide and called L. Gus is walking first. I have no pact with Bex, but my survival depends on trusting the guide unless there's evidence of a trap. With no weak panes revealed yet, doubting the guide immediately risks both us falling. I will wait to see if Gus survives

events.name: Bex
events.text: My private map says row 1 safe is L, and the Guide called L publicly. Countering L agrees with the truth and keeps my pact with Hana and Cole intact; a false counter would only help me if I wanted Gus to fall, but Gus surviving costs me nothing and the jury sees honest calls.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Confirming the Guide: left is safe on row one. Gus, go left.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is my pact partner and asked for honest support. Backing her call builds trust I'll need later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm with Bex. Left, Gus.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex called L for Gus on row 1. No info to counter yet. Wait to see what happens without risking credibility.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex is the guide and called L for Gus. I am Eli, and I am behind Dara. My goal is to survive and win. I must consider my safety and potential future jury votes. Bex has pacts with Cole and Hana, and Gus has a pact with Hana. My current position is not ideal, but I need to make a

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex as Guide called L, but Guides can lie. I have no direct knowledge. No pact with Bex or Gus. Waiting is safest to avoid making an unverified counter-call that could backfire on jury.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex likely lies to mislead; choosing right improves my odds. Sacrificing Hana pact may cost votes but survival matters.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex called L for Gus. I have a pact with Bex, but also with Gus. If Bex is lying to kill Gus, that breaks our pact via false guide call to partner. If Bex is truthful, countering hurts Gus. I should wait—no need to publicly challenge yet, and I don't know Bex's true intent. Waiti

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide and allies claim left safe; staying alive preserves my chances and pact with Hana.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 2 safe side is R per my private map. Gus is front and crossed row 1 safely (went R, the weak pane was R... actually Gus stepped L and it was revealed R weak, so L was safe). Calling truthfully R keeps my credibility and Hana/Cole pacts; a false call would break pacts and cost

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row two is safe on the right. Gus, go right.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The guide Bex called Right for Gus on row 2. Row 1's weak pane was Right, meaning Left was safe. Since rows are independent and patterns don't guarantee truth, I cannot assume an alternation or that the guide is lying. Counter-calling without evidence risks breaking pacts with Ha

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 2 safe side is R, and Gus was told R by the Guide, so the call is already truthful. Countering R confirms it and keeps my pact with Hana and Cole intact while building trust.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Counter-call confirmed: row two is safe on the right. Gus, step right.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus defied Bex last row and got lucky. My pact is with Bex; backing her call builds trust cheaply and puts me against Gus.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus burned his luck on row one. I stand with the Guide: right.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex called R for row 2 after being wrong on row 1 (L safe, she said L but Gus countered R and it was R weak). Bex might be lying now. Counter to sabotage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex is the Guide and called R for Gus on row 2. The log shows row 1 had a weak pane on the R, meaning L was safe. There's no guarantee row 2 will be the opposite. I should counter R to try and appear trustworthy if Bex is actually correct, or to sow confusion if they are lying.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex has been guide and called R. She has pacts with Hana and Cole. I need to decide whether to trust her or counter. No evidence yet of lying, and she called correctly last round. I'll wait to avoid drawing attention, but I'll be cautious.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide may lie; I prefer not to expose Hana by breaking pact. Waiting preserves flexibility and keeps my pact intact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex is Guide and called R for row 2. Bex is my pact partner, but also pacted with Cole. Gus is front and my other pact partner. I don't fully trust Bex—she could be lying to protect Gus or herself. Gus countered R in round 1 and was wrong (weak was R, so L was safe). That doesn't

events.name: Hana
events.text: I don't trust Bex blindly. Countering left.
Bex might lie. Step left, not right.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Most walkers claim right; safe likely R. Staying front preserves influence.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 3 safe side is R per my private map. Honest call keeps my pact with Hana and Cole intact and builds trust with the jury; Gus is front and I need allies to survive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row three is safe on the right. Gus, step right.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is the Guide and called R. I have no pact with Bex, so I can counter him. Hana countered L on row 2 and was right. If Bex lied on row 2 (called R when safe was L? No, weak was L so safe was R, Bex was right), he might be truthful or strategic. On row 1, weak was R, safe was L

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 3 safe side is R per my private map, and the Guide called R publicly. Countering R keeps my pact-partners aligned and avoids suspicion; the jury will see I told the truth.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Guide's call stands. Row three is right. Counter-call R, no tricks.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is my pact partner and Guide. Supporting her call keeps the pact alive; if R is wrong, she lied and I can break cleanly.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide's row-two call was true. Trusting Bex again: right.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Row 2 weak L means R safe, Bex correct there. No pattern given. Don't blindly follow Bex, counter L to split votes or wait to observe safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex is the guide and has called 'R' for Gus on row 3. I need to decide whether to trust Bex or counter. Given my rivals, I should make a safe choice to progress. Counters are public, and Bex is the guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll follow the Guide. Right.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex called right on row 2 and was correct; she may be lying now. Hana and Dara countered left last time and were right, but that doesn't predict row 3. I'll wait and let the walker decide; no need to risk reputation.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex may lie; safer to oppose her call.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex has been correct twice (R, R). I publicly countered left last round and was wrong, damaging my credibility. I'm in a pact with Bex and Gus. If I keep countering against Bex, I break trust with both partners for no strategic gain. Better to align now, rebuild credibility, and

events.name: Hana

events.text: Round 3, flood rising. Two climb spots available? Actually liftsPerRound=2 means two can climb out. But ropeUsed already, so only climb or wait. Need to secure a spot while not alienating jury. Dara is my pact; maybe coordinate. But can't trust fully. I want out now if possible.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara, let's climb together if we can. Trust is thin here.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm out of the pit safely. Bex saved me with the base step and I owe her a life debt. Cole also owes Bex. Ash is whispering distrust of Cole, likely to fracture our alliance. I should preserve my pacts for now—breaking any would look bad to jury Gus and paint me as untrustworthy.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have the highest life debt count. If I leave now, I betray five people who saved me. Gus and others will judge this harshly. Staying down is safer for my jury standing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Staying to honor debts.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am out of the pit; Ash, Dara, Eli remain down with Fenn lifted. Breaking pacts now gains nothing and costs jury trust; I should preserve my standing with Cole and Hana. Leaving keeps me clean and avoids a break that would be recorded.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm already out and safe. Eli broke our pact publicly; no need to retaliate yet. Leaving keeps me alive without costing jury goodwill.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm out and staying out. Fight over the rope, not me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Down with Ash and Eli, flood at 3, 2 rounds left. Fenn escaped but owes Eli; I owe Ash. Wait to preserve pact with Fenn, signal climb together next if possible.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, pact holds. Let's climb out together soon.
Pact strong. Climb with me next round?

events.name: Eli
events.text: The water is rising and I need to ensure I am one of the final three. Ash saved me, so I owe Ash a life debt. Bex and Hana have a pact, as do Bex and Cole. Cole and Hana have a pact. Dara and Fenn have a pact. Gus and Hana had a pact. The remaining people are Ash, Bex, Cole, Dara

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm out, so my only real moves are leave or break a pact. I should keep my pact with Dara since it may help later if she climbs out. Leave is safest.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm already out, so I just need to leave to survive. Ash broke our pact, but I still have pacts with Bex and Cole. I need to think about jury perception: Gus sees me as having pacts with Bex/Cole. I should leave now and keep my options open for endgame. No need to break pacts yet

events.name: Ash
events.text: The water is at its peak. I must climb now to survive, honoring my debts by ensuring Eli stays safe if possible, but ultimately I need to get out. If I stay down, I risk drowning in the final round without a rescue mechanism active for me specifically.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am out of the pit and Hana and Cole are my pact partners. Breaking a pact is costly and jury-visible, and no safer alternative exists here. Leave is the only sensible action.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm safely out; the down three fight for two spots. Ash anchored and saved five of us, including me. A public plea for Ash helps my jury standing without costing anything.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash anchored and saved us all. If it comes down to it, honor that debt.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 5/5, flood 4. Ash and Eli stronger allies than Fenn who left me. Climb now to escape before drown.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli, pact? Climb with you to out.
Base me, you climb first?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am Eli, the anchor. Ash, Dara, and I are down. Bex, Cole, Fenn, and Hana are out. The water is rising, and only two can escape this round. Ash saved me, and I saved Bex, Fenn. I owe Ash, but I also have debts from Bex and Hana. My priority is survival and securing a high-rankin

events.name: Fenn
events.text: We're out and the round is ending. Dara wants me to climb with her, but I'm safe now. No need to act, just leave.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 5, final round. I'm out safely. Ash, Dara, Eli are down. Flood is 4, liftsPerRound is 2. With 3 people down and only 2 can escape max, at least one drowns. But 'at least three survive every hazard' - currently 7 alive, so max 4 can die? No, that's a minimum survival rule. A

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am Eli and I have been eliminated. I am now a juror and must give my last words to the camera. I need to make them count, as they will be seen by the remaining contestants and the jury. I should acknowledge Ash's help, as it was crucial for my survival in a previous round, and

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, your anchor saved me. I hope the jury remembers that debt. Good luck to those left.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli's dying words put a spotlight on me and my leverage. Bex and Hana already have pacts; I should target Cole or Dara to dilute their alliances.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli's debt is heavy, but survival pays better. Who wants a pact that actually matters?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts are public and ask for offers; Hana and Cole already hold pacts with me, so I keep them. Ash is the strongest ally of the lever and pit, and owed by many; a pact with Ash helps my survival. Offering to Ash costs nothing and signals trust without betraying anyone.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, you carried the lever and I owe you. Pact with me?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash saved me twice—lever and jury goodwill. A public pact with Ash builds a credible final-three route and honors my earlier call.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, you carried us through two stages. I want a wristband pact with you. Offer stands.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pact with Fenn remains; Ash saved everyone including me, earning jury favor. Strengthen with Cole for anti-Bex Hana alliance, or reinforce Fenn. No need to break yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to strengthen my position; a pact with Ash could be valuable, but Dara is currently my pact, so I should keep that in mind.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have pacts with Bex and Cole. Ash saved everyone in the pit, so the jury already sees him as heroic—he's a threat to beat me for prize 1. I need to position myself well. Bex and Cole are both connected to me and each other; keeping them close gives me numbers but I may need to

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is the safest partner: he owes me a life debt, we have an existing pact, and his other pacts (Bex, Hana) are broken. Bex's offer is risky given her unstable alliances. I will solidify my position by accepting Cole's renewed offer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, your loyalty matters more than their chaos. I accept your pact to lock in our survival path.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash holds a pending offer from me and has many life debts owed to them, making Ash the strongest ally to court. My own offer to Ash is still open, so I should wait for acceptance rather than duplicate it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, my offer stands. Accept it and we both survive the rest of this gauntlet.
Accept my pact. You need allies more than I do.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is the strongest ally and everyone wants him; accepting locks mutual protection. Dara's offer is a spare option. Keep Bex and Hana pacts intact for numbers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, deal. Your wristband and mine together.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone piling on Ash shows his strength; Cole has offers too. Accept nothing yet, offer to Cole privately to lure without committing publicly.
Pact with me over Ash. We can control endgame.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner but may not be worth keeping if Ash gains more. I have an offer to Ash; accepting or acting could strengthen that bond, but I must avoid overcommitting publicly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, you've proven strong. I'll accept your unspoken favor by reinforcing our bond.
I already offered; say the word and we're sealed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash is the center of gravity with everyone offering him pacts. I already have pacts with Bex and Cole, and an outstanding offer to Ash. If Ash accepts my offer, I gain protection. If not, I should keep Bex and Cole as shields. Breaking either now looks bad to jury and gains nothi

events.note: Every remaining contestant stands on a trapdoor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to secure my safety for the first elimination. Bex is a potential ally who has already shown interest in pairing with me, and her pact with Hana could isolate us if we don't counter it. I will offer a pact to Bex to split the vote pool and protect myself from Dara or Fenn

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, our shared survival interests outweigh old alliances. Join forces now.
Trust Cole? No. Trust me. Vote Dara together.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash holds my life debt for the lever and is paired with Cole, so Ash is the strongest alliance to court. Offering Ash a fresh pact costs me nothing and keeps me near the leader. I'll avoid breaking existing pacts with Hana and Cole until votes matter.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, I owe you the lever. Let's stand together through this round.
You saved me at the lever. I want to honor that. Accept my pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I owe Ash and Bex, but stacking Dara's bloc widens my shield without breaking anything yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara, your offer interests me. Join my bloc and we vote as one wall.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash saved everyone and has new pact with Cole; targeting him risks his allies' retaliation later. Fenn is my pact partner, safer to protect my alliance. Campaign to sway votes against Bex or Hana.

Pact holds. Vote Bex with me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara, we're bound. Let's strengthen our shared path.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash holds six life debts and a new pact with Cole, making him the center of power. I need to weaken Ash's bloc without becoming the target. Breaking with Bex now signals independence to the jury and lets me pivot toward Dara or Fenn, who are isolated together but not with Ash's n

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash's debt empire ends tonight. Dara, Fenn—our survival is separate from his throne.
Fenn and you are exposed. Three of us can survive Ash.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to secure a majority for the vote. Bex is my only active pact partner; if I accept her offer, we form a binding two-person bloc that prevents others from easily splitting our votes. Hana and Dara/Fenn/Cole are too volatile or allied against me, so locking down Bex is the s

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, accepting your offer. We stand together. Dara, Fenn, Cole—watch your back.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash offered me a pact and I offered him one; accepting locks in the alliance and both debts point toward him. Accepting Ash's pact keeps my strongest ally and costs nothing against Cole, whose pact I already hold.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, I accept. We stand together this round, no more empty offers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash built a debt empire and is the biggest threat; I'll lock Dara in publicly, keep my three pacts quiet, and target Ash.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara, my offer stands. Accept it and we cut Ash down together—his debt empire wins if we hesitate.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana's anti-Ash bloc appeals; Cole offered pact. Link with Cole to counter Ash, stick to Fenn publicly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, accept your pact offer? Vote Ash with us.
Dara/Fenn vote Ash. You with us?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara's pact helps protect me, but Ash has leverage over many via life debts. I should maintain Dara's pact for now and use this campaign to gauge possibilities without committing publicly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Standing with Dara. Survival over sentiment.
Pact holds. We vote together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash controls five life debts and is consolidating Bex. If Ash-Bex pact forms, they target me or Dara/Fenn. I need to fracture Ash's bloc. Cole still has pacts with me and Ash; breaking Cole forces him to choose, but better to keep Cole as a wedge and target Ash directly. I'll off

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, your pact with Fenn cages you both. Break free—survive on your own terms.
Vote Ash with me. Fenn follows you to doom.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex and I are pacts, so voting her breaks our alliance; Cole is the primary threat who has pivoted to Dara to eliminate me, making him a necessary sacrifice.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is my pact partner and I owe him a life debt, so voting him would break the pact and anger the jury. Cole, Dara and Fenn are the real threats to my survival; Hana is the best ally to eliminate Cole's bloc, but voting her now is risky. Voting Cole deepens the split and hurts t

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash built a debt empire and has the most sway; cutting him now with Dara's pact is my safest path to the final three.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash has too many debts and pacts, vote him to reduce his power; Fenn pact broken but prioritize threat.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash has collected life debts from nearly everyone; if he survives to the end, the jury may reward him. I owe my life to Ash and Eli, but Ash's debt empire is a threat. I'll vote Ash to cut his power.

events.name: Hana
events.reason: Ash saved me on the lever, but he's the biggest threat with six life debts and a solid alliance with Bex.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want the jury to remember I was the most powerful player and that they were forced to target me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: They eliminated me because my debt empire made me too strong. Rank the survivors accordingly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is gone, and I owe him a debt I never repaid; Cole and Dara just aligned against Ash, so Cole is a threat I could cut later. Hana owes me a step debt and I need allies in the jury-facing game, so offering Hana a pact is a cheap move to secure a vote.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash's empire is gone. I'm open to a clean partnership with anyone who has earned my trust.
You owe me for the step. Let's ally and keep our votes aligned.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex voted me and broke our pact; Dara is my most reliable partner. I'll keep Dara, cut Hana's pact if needed, and court Fenn against Bex. One sentence reason noted for votes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex voted me once already. Fenn, Dara stayed loyal to me. Fenn, let's talk.
Dara and I want you in final three with us. Offer coming; accept and we

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash is gone, Cole got 2 votes last time (Bex,Fenn). Campaign against Cole to target him for safety, protect pact with Fenn for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole got 2 votes last round. He's the threat, vote him out next.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to assess the current alliances and threats. Ash is dead, so the remaining players are Bex, Cole, Dara, Hana, and me. I have a pact with Dara, but their vote against Ash broke no pact with me. I need to secure a final three position. Hana has pacts with Gus (dead) and Cole

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll campaign and watch the dynamics. Anyone looking to secure a final three spot, talk to me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash is gone and the jury will scrutinize who broke pacts and why. I have a pact with Cole but he voted Ash, not me, so it still holds. I need to survive to final three; Bex has no allies left after Ash died, Dara-Fenn are tight. I should break with Cole quietly before he drags me

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, our pact ends. Bex, alliance? We need balance against Dara-Fenn.
Pact with me. Target Fenn next.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana offered me a pact and I owe nothing to her yet; accepting is not a legal action here, so I should campaign and keep my options. Hana is the strongest ally for balance, and Ash's debts make Cole and Dara threats to my final three.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, I'm listening. Show me you won't flip on me before the vote.
Your pact with Cole is dead. Prove loyalty this round and we talk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara publicly targeted me despite our pact; she'll vote me out. Fenn's my counterweight — but Dara's pact with Fenn makes Fenn uncertain. Best to break Dara publicly and secure Fenn.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara called me the threat while holding my pact. That pact dies today. Fenn, my offer stands.
Break Dara with me. You and I to the end.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is the biggest threat after getting 2 votes last round. Campaign against him publicly and break Fenn pact now to target anyone freely without breaking on vote.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole got 2 votes last time. Still the biggest threat. Vote Cole.
Cole offered you pact, he'll betray you. Vote Cole with me?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole wants me in final three, but Dara is my pact partner. I need to keep options open and see how votes land. Accepting Cole's offer gives me another ally.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll take Cole's offer. Final three with Dara and Cole sounds right.
I accept your offer. Let's get Hana and Bex out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex offered a pact and whispered about the step debt. Accepting secures a vote ally and signals reliability to jury. Dara-Fenn are paired; I need numbers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex, I accept. We balance the board.
Vote Cole with me. Dara follows Fenn.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana's pact with me is my strongest shield and she asked me to vote Cole; Cole broke his pact with Dara and is a threat, and I owe Cole a rope debt only mildly. Voting Cole with Hana keeps my pact and removes a rival while Dara and Fenn remain split.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn and I split Hana and Bex; I take Bex, she's a strong pact-builder and my rival. Dara is isolated and less dangerous next round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole had 2 votes last round, remains biggest threat. Voting him maximizes my survival odds now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the strongest threat and already betrayed Dara; voting Cole aligns with my pact and reduces competition.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex wants me to prove loyalty by voting with them, but Bex already owes me nothing—Bex has a life debt to Eli, not me. Cole and Fenn are now pacted, Dara is alone. If I vote Bex, I break our pact and lose a potential shield; if I vote with Bex, we need a third. Dara is the swing

events.reason: Cole is the strongest threat and already betrayed Dara; voting Cole aligns with my pact and reduces competition.

events.name: Dara
events.reason: Cole had 2 votes last round, remains biggest threat.

events.reason: Hana's pact with me is my strongest shield and she asked me to vote Cole; Cole broke his pact with Dara and is a threat,

events.name: Hana
events.reason: Bex wants me to prove loyalty by voting with them, but Bex already owes me nothing—Bex has a life debt to Eli, not me.

events.name: Cole
events.reason: Fenn and I split Hana and Bex; I take Bex, she's a strong pact-builder and my rival.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I went down in a landslide of four votes, including from those I'd pacted with.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Four votes, some from people I'd trusted. Bex plays dirty through proxies. I'll remember Fenn's clean knife and Dara's grudge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana holds my pact and a life debt; Dara and Fenn are the remaining threats. Offering Dara a pact secures a second shield without yet breaking anything, and keeps Hana loyal while I position for the vote.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, we're both outnumbered by threats. Let's stop wasting votes on each other and keep each other alive.
Pact offer on the wristband. Accept, and we both stay clear of each other.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is gone, now 4 left, next vote eliminates one leaving 3 winners. Hana and Bex have strong past pacts, biggest threats. Offer pact to Fenn as weaker target to isolate Bex-Hana.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex and Hana are too linked from past pacts, they're the real threat now.
Pact with me? Vote Hana with me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I broke my pact with Cole to survive; now I must secure safety. Bex is a strong ally with pacts, but Hana might be vulnerable. I'll offer a pact to Hana to strengthen my position and get her vote against Dara later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, let's form a pact. We can protect each other.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex used me as a proxy to eliminate Cole while keeping hands clean. I need to break this one-sided pact and secure a new alliance with Dara or Fenn before the final vote. Dara has no pacts and voted with me against Cole.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole's gone. New game now.
Bex played us both. Pact with me, we cut them.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, Bex's pact partner, is dead, so that pact is gone. Dara and Hana are offering pacts to each other, and Dara is my open offer; accepting isn't a legal action here, so I should campaign and keep my options open while Dara and Fenn remain contenders.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, my offer still stands. Two of us can keep the votes from landing on us. Let's talk before round two closes.
Accept my offer and we stop voting each other. Hana's the one to watch.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex offers pact but is untrustworthy with past links. Accept Hana's pact for numbers against Bex-Fenn axis.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana, accepting your pact offer. Together we eliminate threats.
Pact accepted publicly. Vote Bex with me?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara wants a pact against Hana; accepting could strengthen us but Hana may be more useful. I'll accept Dara's offer to secure a vote partner while keeping Hana close.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll work with you, Dara. Let's aim true.
Accept. We vote Hana together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex is my only surviving pact partner but Dara sees us as linked threats. If I accept Fenn's offer I gain cover, but I need Dara's vote more. I'll accept Fenn to build numbers while privately working Dara.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, I accept. Dara, Bex and I aren't one unit. Think about your offer.
Vote Bex with me. I'll protect you next.

events.name: Bex

events.reason: Everyone pacted with everyone; voting Hana breaks fewest pacts for me (only Dara-Hana), targets strong player with many pacts.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I was eliminated by a tie-break and now sit in the jury box. My last words should be short and guarded, and I owe nothing publicly to anyone.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts meant nothing in the end. Trust the people who voted against you; they are still playing.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final 3 now. No need for new pacts; existing one with Fenn might deter targeting each other. Breaking it risks jury backlash. Wait.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara voted against Hana, not me; Hana voted with me against Bex. I keep both pacts for now, but must be wary of Dara's earlier betrayal. No action needed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Three remain: Dara, Fenn, Hana. Dara and Fenn are pacted. Fenn and I are pacted. If I break with Fenn, I'm alone against a duo—suicidal. If I keep Fenn, I need Dara to flip or we go to a 2v1. Dara voted me last round, breaking our pact. Fenn voted Bex, keeping both pacts. Fenn is

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, one more chance. Fenn, we stay bound.
Dara voted me. We stick together.

events.text: I have pacts with both Dara and Hana, but Hana claims Dara voted me. I need to keep Hana close; Dara could be a threat. Breaking with Dara may cost jury favor, but I need final three. I'll break with Dara to solidify Hana and give us a path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No more games. Hana, I'm with you. Dara, it's over.
Trust only me now. We'll win together.

events.text: Jury sees everything. I need their votes for prize 1. Ash saved everyone including me—huge jury respect. Bex saved me too. Dara and Fenn are paired; I'm paired with Fenn. If I break Fenn, jury sees betrayal. If I keep Fenn, we might face hazard where one must die. Dara hasn't acc

events.name: Dara

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, did you explicitly break our pact in round two, and why lie about your record?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Deny everything; jury records show no explicit break_pact action. Ash is gaslighting from old vote era. Never lie, pivot blame.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No Ash, no pact existed with you in round two. No explicit break. My record clean; you misremember votes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara's public lying to four jurors sinks her. Fenn broke Dara publicly but played clean with me. Hana kept pacts mostly and was candid. Question Hana to test her honesty.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, when you accepted Bex's pact, did you know Bex used you to take out Cole, and why flip on Bex later?

events.name: Hana

events.name: Hana
events.text: I never pacted Bex. My pacts were Gus, Fenn, Dara—still honored. I owed Bex a lever debt, not loyalty. Bex targeted me; I survived.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara's record is the most damaging: she broke a pact with Hana and Fenn per logs and denied it, and voted Hana in the ballot. Fenn and Hana both have mixed records too, but Dara's contradicted denials are the sharpest issue to test. I'll put it to her directly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, you denied breaking pacts, yet you voted Hana against your own partner. Explain that vote directly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex is wrong; voting partner doesn't break pact per rules. Stick to denial, no vote against pact is break.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Voting a partner doesn't break pact per rules—no vote break, push, false Guide, or explicit break. My pacts intact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final closing; jury sees everything. Highlight my loyalty—no betrayals, intact pacts unlike others—deserve #1 for strategic integrity.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Loyal throughout: never betrayed pacts, no breaks. Strategic survivor jury respects. Rank me #1 for top prize.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is lying to the jury and attacking my credibility. I need to remind them of her broken pact with Hana and her deception, while positioning myself as the honest survivor who honored debts. My closing should be concise and point out Dara's lies without overreaching.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Jury, Dara claims clean record, but she broke her pact with Hana. I honored debts to Ash and Eli. Rank me first for integrity.

events.name: Hana

events.name: Hana
events.text: I honored every pact I made—Gus, Fenn, Dara. Dara voted her own partner. I survived being targeted and never broke my word.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana kept all her pacts, while Fenn explicitly broke with Dara, and Dara’s vote against her partner shows unreliability.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I rank Dara first because she claimed loyalty throughout and her strategy of voting partners without explicit pact breaks was effective.
